config.name: Toto
config.notes: Toto-Open-Base-1.0 (the paper-1 era model). Newer Datadog/Toto-2.0-* family exists on HF (4m, 22m, 313m, 1B, 2.5B); not surveyed.

config.name: Reverso
config.notes: 2.6M model. GitHub README still says 'coming soon', but HF repo shinfxh/reverso-base (updated 2026-04-06) has config 8 layers d_model=128 (the paper's 2.6M spec) and an 11.5 MB model.safetensors. Mapping reverso-base = 2.6M is inferred from that match, not stated by the authors. HF card has no licence; GitHub repo is MIT.

config.name: reverso-small
config.notes: 550K model (4 layers, d_model=64). HF card has no licence; GitHub repo is MIT.

config.name: InceptionTime
